profile.headline: Software Engineer III @ JPMorganChase
profile.summary: Software engineer with broad full stack experience, currently specializing in data pipeline development and large-scale data transformations using Databricks.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Build and maintain scalable data pipelines that ingest and transform large datasets in Databricks to support analytics and downstream business use cases.

Use Java and PySpark on AWS, with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code, to deliver reliable, high-performance data solutions tailored to end-user needs.

positions.title: Senior Research Analyst
positions.description:
- Led the U.S. fixed income and real assets manager research teams. Evaluated investment managers and made recommendations to the investment committee. Took point on search activity within these asset classes for the firm's clients, which included corporate, pension, foundation and high net worth investors.
- Implemented and utilized new technologies at the firm in order to enhance how investment manager data was included in client presentations.
- Served as a point of contact for client inquiries regarding their investment portfolios. Presented investment performance and updates on capital markets at client board meetings.
- Created and updated client investment reports, meeting materials and addressed other ad hoc requests under tight timelines.
- Promoted to Senior Research Analyst in December of 2016.

positions.title: Performance Analyst
positions.description:
-Reconciled and calculated monthly investment performance for assigned clients.

-Assisted in the due diligence process for current and potential investment managers as a member of the fixed income manager research team.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: -Supported a Senior Financial Representative in day to day management of clients and their investment portfolios.
